t: Pack of 2 Forge Steel F-Clamps offers robust clamping for various trade applications. Ideal for use during woodworking, metalworking, and general assembly tasks, to provide secure hold-down work for gluing or fabrication. Each 300mm (12") F-clamp features an I-beam design, ensuring higher mechanical strength and reduced torsion during heavy use. Soft plastic jaw guards help prevent damage to workpieces, while the ergonomic polypropylene handles deliver improved comfort and a reliable grip for precise adjustments.
b: I-Beam Design for High Strength & Less Torsion
